title: Giants pursuing 'aggressive' strategy as trade deadline approaches: 'We’re turning over every stone'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants pursuing 'aggressive' strategy as trade deadline approaches: 'We’re turning over every stone'
sources.description: With just nine days to go to the NFL Trade Deadline, Giants head coach John Harbaugh said the team is doing everything it can to fill some of the injury-induced holes New York's roster has suffered through the first half of the season.
